title: Lifting the bottom structural ring map of a geometric square
statement: For small sites J,K,J',K', ring sheaves A,B,A',B', geometric ring data f:A→B,g:A→A',e:B→B', and α:e.inverse⋙f.inverse≅H⋙g.inverse, assume g.inverse is full and faithful and g.ringMap invertible. Define r as the unique preimage under g.inverse of α⁻¹ at |B'| followed by f.inverse(e.ringMap), f.ringMap and g.ringMap⁻¹. For any adjunction H⊣R with H left exact, these are geometric ring data h:A'→B'. The square of structural maps commutes, using α.

source.place: Tag 03CR, proof: structural map carried through the fixed geometric square.

proof.text: Take the fully faithful preimage of the displayed map as r. The map-preimage identity and naturality of α show, for every generalized element x:T→|B'|, that g.inverse(H(x);r);g.ringMap = α⁻¹_T;f.inverse(e.inverse(x);e.ringMap);f.ringMap.

Apply the top and right ring identities to the right side, evaluated on the section obtained by α⁻¹_T. The reflection lemmas for g yield zero, one, addition and multiplication for H followed by r. Bundle H,R and the supplied adjunction with these laws.
Expand r, use map-preimage, then cancel α with its inverse and the invertible structural map with its inverse. This is the final square equation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit Lean construction and operation calculations, expanding the transport details omitted in Tag 03CR.
